entries.title: Meeple Station

emulation.notes: Use the native desktop release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Meeple Station is a space-station colony/base-building sim released on Steam on April 10, 2020 after a 2019 Early Access launch. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux/SteamOS, plus a level editor. No console or mobile release was found in this pass. Windows PC is the preferred archive route because it has the cleanest capture path and broadest practical tooling support.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release for the main archive route. Use macOS or Linux only as native convenience alternatives.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with level editor support and the strongest capture/settings route.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest practical archive route among sourced native desktop versions.
